facts.text: I woke up with a tattoo and no car, but the fridge is full of pudding. Let's eat first and retrace it after.
facts.why: Jesse never says this, and the pudding is in the kitchen cabinets and cupboards, not the fridge. It works as a note from Jesse if the pudding is in the cupboards.
facts.fix: I woke up with a tattoo and no car, but the cupboards are full of pudding. Let's eat first and retrace it after.

facts.text: Fridge full of chocolate pudding pots
facts.why: In the transcript Jesse says he always wondered what a fridge full of pudding would look like, so the fridge is in the film as well as the cabinets.

vibe.verdict: Fun poster and tone with the And then drive-through and pudding in, but the real drive-thru order is missing from the mains.
missing: The real drive-through order: garlic chicken, white rice, wonton soup, fortune cookies (Jesse)
The Sweet and Dude tattoos, and Mr Lee telling them what they say (the tailor)
The Rubik's Cube that turns into the Continuum Transfunctioner (Chester)
Captain Stu's Space-O-Rama arcade and mini golf (the finale)
The lifetime supply of pudding won with a hole in one on the 18th hole (the Norwegian aliens)
ideas: Swap 'Drive-through lemon chicken and fried rice' for 'Garlic chicken, white rice, wonton soup and fortune cookies'.
Swap 'Tattoo parlour pork spring rolls' note for 'Your tattoo says dude. Your tattoo says sweet.'
Swap 'Zoltan's popping candy caramel corn' for 'Rubik's Cube chocolate bark'.
Swap the receipt 'Pudding receipt' for a hole in one lifetime pudding voucher from the 18th hole.
